title: Settings

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: How Stockly looks and reads on this device.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Follow the device, or pick one.

density.label: Density
density.description: How tightly tables pack their rows.

language.title: Language
language.label: Language
language.description: The language Stockly uses for its own wording and dates. It never changes a figure, a currency or a timezone — those are separate settings.
language.note: Your choice is remembered on this device, and on any device you sign in to.

currencyNote: Currency is a property of each portfolio, not of the language you read it in.
timezoneNote: Times are shown in your device's timezone, whichever language you choose.

push.title: Push notifications
push.hint: Per device. Enabling on your phone does not enable on your laptop.

appliesToBoth: Applies to both in-app and push.
notificationsHint: Choose what Stockly tells you about, and how.
setupRequiredBody: Copy .env.example to .env.local, fill in NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, apply supabase/migrations, then restart the dev server.
